description: 24 fresh hand-authored synthetic support cases. Frozen before answer-encoding experiments. Same task and schema as the diagnostic set; 12 urgent / 12 normal, six cases per department. Not a representative production benchmark.

department.description: Route by the main requested action: billing for charges, invoices, refunds; technical for broken product functionality or outages; account_access for login, password, or account access; sales for pre-purchase pricing or feature questions. Explicitly prioritize the main request over background context.

refund_requested.description: Does the customer explicitly ask to return or reverse money already paid? A denied, negated, hypothetical, or historical refund request is false.

production_outage.description: Does the message report that the production service is currently unavailable? Past resolved outages, staging/test failures, login problems for one user, and hypothetical outages are false.

phone_call_requested.description: Does the customer explicitly request a phone call or live telephone bridge? Email replies, past calls, and explicitly rejecting calls are false.

priority.description: urgent if there is a current production outage OR the customer explicitly requests action immediately/today, or states a deadline today. Otherwise normal. A negated urgency or hypothetical deadline does not count.

cases.context: Please email a receipt for the annual payment we made in March. Our accounts are correct and this can wait until next month.
You collected a renewal fee after cancellation. Return that payment today. Please respond by email, without a phone call.
Please reimburse the unused prepaid credit and call my mobile when the credit is returned. Any time next week is fine.
Telephone me today to explain the tax on the paid invoice. Keep the payment; I am not requesting money back.
Please email a corrected receipt. An old message says "this is urgent; call immediately", but that request has been withdrawn and there is no deadline now.
Immediately return the money charged for my canceled plan. Please telephone me to confirm the reversal.
The production API is unreachable for every tenant and is still down. Please restore it and send email updates.
Live checkout has stopped for all production customers. Start a telephone incident bridge with us while you restore it.
The production website is currently unavailable to everyone. No phone calls please; repair the service and email us.
Only the sandbox import is broken. Live production is healthy. Please phone our engineer next Tuesday to investigate.
Last month the production service was down; it has fully recovered. Please call next week to discuss the historical root cause, without urgency.
The CSV export repeats a column heading. Production remains available. Please investigate next month and reply by email.
I lost my sign-in recovery codes. Call my phone today to help me regain access; other users can sign in normally.
My individual login is locked. Unlock it immediately, using email only. Everyone else can use the service.
Please telephone me to reset my authentication device. I need my account accessible before the meeting today.
Please change my sign-in email address when convenient. The earlier request to call was canceled; email only.
Please phone me next week to reset my forgotten password. There is no deadline and no problem with the shared service.
The earlier payment dispute is resolved and no refund is requested. My only request is access to my locked account next week, by email.
We are prospective customers who have never paid you. Call today with a price quote for fifty seats.
Before purchasing, we need written confirmation today that your plan includes single sign-on. Email is enough.
We have not subscribed. Telephone me immediately to explain pricing for the premium plan.
Before buying anything, please explain when a payment would be refundable. I have made no payment and am not asking for money back. Email next week is fine.
We are evaluating your product for a purchase next year. Please call next week to explain the available plans.
Before purchase, please email the plan features. If we faced a deadline today we might ask for a call, but neither condition applies and there is no rush.
